methods.name: show_help_topic
methods.summary: Look for and, if found, show a help topic.
methods.description: Requests that the help backend look for a help topic and, if found, show it. If the topic is found, it will be shown via a Show Help notification. If the topic is not found, no notification will be delivered.

schema.description: Whether the topic was found and shown. Topics are shown via a Show Help notification.

methods.name: search_help
methods.summary: Search the active interpreter's help system.
methods.description: Searches interpreter-wide help and displays the resulting page via a Show Help notification.

params.name: query
params.description: The help query to search for

params.name: search_id
params.description: Opaque identifier supplied by the frontend for this UI search. Echo it in the resulting Show Help notification.

schema.description: Whether the search results navigation was requested. This does not confirm that the frontend displayed or finished loading the page.

methods.name: get_help_topics
methods.description: Returns at most limit matching help topic suggestions, filtered and ranked by the backend. An empty query returns no suggestions.

params.name: query
params.description: The text to match against help topic labels.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return, from 1 to 50.

help_topic_suggestion.description: A help topic offered as an autocomplete suggestion.

label.description: The topic label shown to the user.

topic.description: The exact topic value used to open help.

detail.description: Optional context such as the package containing the topic.
